lines.en: label beachsevenami1:
scene amibeachteleportation1
: Daddy! Hi! I’ve been looking all over the place for you! And I promise it’s for perfectly normal reasons!
lines.zh: : 爸爸!嗨!我找你找遍了每个角落!而且我保证,完全是出于正常得不得了的理由!

lines.en: : Wow, what a perfectly normal thing to say.
lines.zh: : 哇,多么正常得不得了一句话。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation2
: Whatcha doing all the way over here when there are over fifteen girls in swimsuits just ten miles down the shore where everybody else is hanging out?
lines.zh: : 海岸线往那边十里,十五个穿泳装的女孩正扎堆,你一个人跑这么远在这儿干嘛?

lines.en: : Ten miles? You mean to tell me I’ve managed to walk ten miles during the brief off-screen interlude that just happened?
lines.zh: : 十里?你是说我刚才那段画面外的小插曲里,居然走了十里路?

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation3

: Ahh, okay. That explains it. You always do this thing where you start to dematerialize off screen and, if nobody stops you in time, your particles are reassembled somewhere else within a ten mile radius.
lines.zh: : 啊,明白了。这就说得通了。你老是这样——一出了画面就开始解体,要是没人及时拦住,你的粒子就会在十英里半径内随机重组。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation1
: And while it sucks that you hit the distance cap, no cloud is without its silver stomach lining because NOW you get to give me a piggyback ride all the way back to everyone else!
lines.zh: : 虽然你撞上距离上限很遗憾,但每朵乌云都镶着银色的胃壁——因为「现在」你得背我一路回到大家那里!

lines.en: : Unless of course you’d like me to go home and fuck myself like you did last night by coming here with all of my friends without so much as inviting me. That’s fine, though!
lines.zh: : 当然了,除非你想让我回家自己解决,就像你昨晚那样——带着我所有的朋友来这里,却连邀请我一声都没有。不过没关系!

lines.en: : It doesn’t sound fine.
lines.zh: : 听起来不像没关系。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation4
: Because it’s not.
lines.zh: : 因为确实有关系。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation1
: So, what were you guys doing? Orgy? Are you into Dungeons & Dragons now? Was it an orgy?
lines.zh: : 那么,你们刚才在干什么?群P?你们现在玩上龙与地下城了?是群P吗?

lines.en: : You know how I feel about orgies, Ami. I just saw a few of them naked and then ran away to go talk to Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你知道我对群P的态度,Ami。我只是看了几个人一眼、然后跑去找 Yumi 聊天。

lines.en: : Why Yumi? Yumi isn’t special and there is nothing special about her apart from how satisfying it would be to pound each of her tsundere holes into oblivion.
lines.zh: : 为什么找 Yumi?Yumi 一点都不特别,她身上没有任何特别的东西——除了把她那两个傲娇的洞挨个干到毁灭会有多爽。

lines.en: : Ami, I think we need to talk.
lines.zh: : Ami,我觉得我们需要谈谈。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation5
: No!
: Oh, okay.
lines.zh: : 哦,好吧。

lines.en: : In fact, now’s the actual worst time for the two of us to talk since you are rapidly losing your grip on reality! And it’s probably because you’re thinking of talking to me! Which is bad! Don’t do it!
lines.zh: : 事实上,现在才是我们俩最不该谈的时候,因为你正在迅速失去对现实的把控!而这多半是因为你在想要不要找我谈!这很糟!别谈!

lines.en: : You’re just afraid of getting grounded again.
lines.zh: : 你只是怕又被禁足。

lines.en: : No, silly! I’m afraid I’ll lose the last remaining thing I love! Which becomes increasingly more probable the more unstable the ground we stand upon becomes!
lines.zh: : 不,傻瓜!我怕的是失去我爱的最后一样东西!而我们脚踩的地面越不稳定,这件事的概率就越高!

lines.en: : What do you know that I don’t?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么我不知道的事?

lines.en: : What, you mean besides everything?
lines.zh: : 怎么,除了「一切」之外的意思吗?

lines.en: : Yeah. Write it all out on a sheet of paper that I’ll forget about after being sent to a different timeline where you didn’t write it. I want more difficult details I can refer to as plot holes.
lines.zh: : 对。把它全写在一张纸上——然后送到另一条你没写过它的时间线里的我,看过就忘的那种。我要更难的细节,好让我把它们称作剧情漏洞。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation6
: But the only hole you need is right here. Mouth hole. The hole that is both inside of and is also my mouth.
lines.zh: : 但你唯一需要的洞就在这里。嘴洞。既在我体内、同时又是我的嘴的那个洞。

lines.en: : Mouth hole does sound good right now. But I can’t help but feel like you’re only here to distract me from my goal of accidentally erasing someone again.
lines.zh: : 嘴洞现在听着确实很诱人。但我总觉得,你在这里只是为了分散我的注意力——免得我又「不小心」抹掉某个人。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation7
: Wow, I wonder what all of those things in the background are? Body bags? I better not draw any attention to them to further complicate the scenario in play here!
lines.zh: : 哇,真好奇背景里那一堆堆东西是什么?尸袋?我最好别把它们指出来,免得把眼前这场戏搞得更复杂!

lines.en: : What’s going on with the water?
lines.zh: : 水怎么了?

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation8
: It’s wet. Like me. Why?
lines.zh: : 水是湿的。和我一样。为什么这么问?

lines.en: : Just wondering.
lines.zh: : 就是随便问问。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation9
: Sauna!
lines.zh: : 桑拿!

lines.en: : Oh.
: Be more impressed! I just moved us over nine miles without even blinking! Reward me for all of my hard work by going back to normal!
lines.zh: : 惊叹一声!我刚把我们俩瞬移了九英里,眼睛都没眨!快用恢复正常来犒赏我的辛勤工作!

lines.en: : Me? You’re the one who’s being weird right now. Nobody else I know intentionally teleports me into saunas.
lines.zh: : 我?现在奇怪的是你。我认识的人里没有谁会故意把我传送到桑拿房里。

lines.en: : That’s because nobody else has had a creepy and/or intimate encounter with you inside one of them yet! And I won’t be able to say that for much longer, so take advantage of me now!
lines.zh: : 那是因为还没别人和你在桑拿房里有过诡异和/或亲密的相遇!而且这话说不了多久了,趁现在赶紧利用我!

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation10
: And by “me” I mean “it.” But only if you’re on the Anti-Ami route, which runs parallel to the more politically correct Pro-Ami route. No conditional dialogue this time, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 我说的「利用我」其实是「利用它」。前提是你走 Anti-Ami 路线——那条与政治正确的 Pro-Ami 路线平行的路线。可惜这次没有条件分支对话。

lines.en: : It’s so hot in here that I’m forgetting the entire point of my panic attack right now.
lines.zh: : 这里热得我都忘了刚才惊恐发作是为了什么了。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation11
: Great! Now follow that train of thought until it SPADs and no one wants to hire you for their railway company anymore!
lines.zh: : 太好了!那就顺着这个思路一直想,直到它 SPAD 掉、再也没有铁路公司愿意雇你为止!

lines.en: : We’re a normal family! I’m a normal girl and you’re a normal guy! And Niki’s a normal lady with a normal sister and I’m the only one who doesn’t mandatorily receive your semen because life is cruel.
lines.zh: : 我们是一家人!我是正常女孩,你是正常男人!Niki 是正常女士,带着一个正常的妹妹——而我是唯一没有被强制接收你的精液的,因为人生残酷。

lines.en: : That’s a problem for another day, though. How many fingers am I holding up?
lines.zh: : 不过那是另一天的问题了。我现在竖了几根手指?

lines.en: : I don’t know. They’re currently off screen.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。它们目前在画面外。

lines.en: : Then tilt the camera down, idiot!
lines.zh: : 那把镜头往下倾啊,笨蛋!

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation12
: I still can’t tell. One hand is clipping into your body and the other hand is behind your left thigh.
lines.zh: : 还是看不清。一只手 clipping 进了你身体,另一只手在你的左大腿后面。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation13
: Wait a minute, when did you pierce your belly button? I didn’t give you permission to do that.
lines.zh: : 等等,你什么时候打的脐钉?我没批准你打。

lines.en: : I did it myself with a safety pin to bring this outfit together and remind you of things that never happened! Plus, it’ll be a fun Easter egg for anyone who’s watched me get shot before!
lines.zh: : 我自己用别针穿的,好搭配这身衣服、顺便提醒你一些「从未发生过」的事!另外,对看过我被枪击的观众来说,这也是个有趣的彩蛋!

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation14
: Ami, you’re not allowed to get shot either. I don’t understand why you keep doing things without my permission. You are out of control and I don’t know what to do about it anymore.
lines.zh: : Ami,你也不许被枪击。我不明白你为什么做什么都不经过我批准。你彻底失控了,我不知道还能怎么办了。

lines.en: : Well, who says you need to do anything? I’m kind of like Antarctica.
lines.zh: : 嗯,谁说我需要你做什么来着?我有点像南极洲。

lines.en: : I’m going to need you to elaborate on that one, red daughter.
lines.zh: : 这条我需要你展开讲讲,红毛女儿。

lines.en: : Because Antarctica isn’t governed by a single body, but instead regulated by the Antarctic Treaty System which includes a bunch of different countries from all over the globe. Duuuuuuuuuuuuuh.
lines.zh: : 因为南极洲不受任何一个实体管辖,而是由《南极条约体系》规制——里面有来自全球的一堆不同国家。嘟————。

lines.en: : I mean that you have no control over me and that my freedom is just a farce since everyone else has decided that I am important enough to turn into a slave.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是:你对我毫无掌控,而我的自由只是一场闹剧——因为其他所有人都已裁定,我重要到值得被变成奴隶。

lines.en: : No daughter of mine is allowed to be a slave either.
lines.zh: : 我的女儿也不许当奴隶。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation15
: Grave!
lines.zh: : 墓碑!

lines.en: : Stop taking after the tombstone behind you. You and I both know that each time we rhyme, we- oh no. It’s happening again.
lines.zh: : 别越来越像你身后的那块墓碑。你我都很清楚,我们每押一次韵,就会——哦不。又来了。

lines.en: : How come everybody gets to see my mom but me? Do you have any idea how many times I’ve come here? I even tried to dig her up once until I realized it was just my other dad down there.
lines.zh: : 为什么所有人都能见到我妈,唯独我不能?你知道我来过这里多少次吗?我甚至试过把她挖出来——直到我发现底下埋的只是我的另一个爸爸。

lines.en: : Don’t talk about him. I’m your dad and you’re my cute little zygote.
lines.zh: : 别提他。我是你爸爸,你是我可爱的小受精卵。

lines.en: : That’s what I think too! But despite what either one of us thinks, he was a person who actually existed! And he both fed me and had a ton of sex with Mom!
lines.zh: : 我也是这么想的!但不管我们怎么想,他是一个真实存在过的人!他喂过我饭,还和妈妈做了超多次爱!

lines.en: : You don’t need to remind me, Ami. I’ve smelled his pee before.
lines.zh: : 你不用提醒我,Ami。我闻过他的尿。

lines.en: : Gross! When can I see my mom again?
lines.zh: : 恶心!我什么时候能再见到妈妈?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Go talk to Kaori. She’s wearing her heart.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。去和 Kaori 聊聊吧。她身上戴着她的心脏。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation16
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!

lines.en: : You really didn’t know? But you seem to know so many things that nobody else knows. Like how to teleport nine miles or Antarctica facts.
lines.zh: : 你真的不知道?可你明明知道那么多别人不知道的事。比如怎么瞬移九英里,或者南极洲冷知识。

lines.en: : Are you telling me my mom’s been inside of Kaori this whole time?!
lines.zh: : 你是想告诉我,我妈这一直都在 Kaori 的体内?!

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. I’m having a hard time controlling my informational output at the moment.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上,对。我暂时有点控制不住自己的信息输出。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation17
: Beach again. Why did you keep this from me?
lines.zh: : 又是海滩。你为什么一直瞒着我?

lines.en: : To protect you.
lines.zh: : 为了保护你。

lines.en: : From what? Closure?
lines.zh: : 保护我远离什么?一个了断?

lines.en: : Hey, don’t yell at me. I’m broken right now. And you’re not without your own flaws in the informational output department, red daughter.
lines.zh: : 嘿,别冲我吼。我现在碎着呢。而且论信息输出部门,你自己也未必干净,红毛女儿。

lines.en: : Maya kept a ton of stuff from you too and that didn’t stop you from falling in love with her for the, like, trillionth time. How come it’s only bad when I do it?
lines.zh: : Maya 瞒了你一大堆事,也没妨碍你第……一万亿次地爱上她。怎么偏偏我做了就是坏事?

lines.en: : Maya never KILLED people you big, dumb dummy!
lines.zh: : Maya 从来没有「杀过人」,你这个又大又蠢的笨蛋!

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation18

: She’s killed tons of people! We all have! You really think there’s only one yandere in a class of twenty neuro-divergent nymphomaniacs?! Every one of us has become obsessed and done unspeakable things in the-
lines.zh: : 她杀过一大堆人!我们全都杀过!你真觉得,一个班二十个神经多样的花痴里,只会有一个病娇?!我们每个人都痴迷过、都做过说不出口的——

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation19
: Hahah! Nope! You almost got me to say things! My compassion has become my weakness once again!
lines.zh: : 哈哈!不!你差点套出我的话!我的同情心再一次成了我的弱点!

lines.en: : Does “everybody” include all of the side characters too? Because Maki’s been making me question some things lately.
lines.zh: : 「所有人」也包括那些配角吗?因为 Maki 最近让我开始质疑一些事。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation20
: I have no idea what you’re talking about. But, if I did, I’d probably remind you that no one you encounter is without purpose, Dad. At least among those of us you can see.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。不过,我要是知道,我大概会提醒你:你遇到的每一个人都有他的用途,爸爸。至少在你看得见的那些人里。

lines.en: : Maki. Chinami. Karin. Sara. Even that little gremlin, Nao-chan.
lines.zh: : Maki。Chinami。Karin。Sara。就连那只小妖怪,Nao 酱。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation21

: You’re gonna have to collect everybody in one life if you want to actually do anything about any of this. No secret hole or slumber party is going to give you any answers a sea of hungry vaginas can’t.
lines.zh: : 你得在一条命里把所有人收集齐,才谈得上对此真正做点什么。不管什么秘密洞穴还是睡衣派对,能给你的答案都不会比一片饥渴的穴海更多。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation22
: But that’s all you’re getting out of me! I’m off to go find Kaori now and RIP HER FUCKING HEART OUT.
lines.zh: : 但你能从我这里掏出来的就这些了!我这就去找 Kaori,把她的心脏活生生地挖出来。

lines.en: : Please don’t kill anyone because of things I revealed in the midst of my delusions, Ami. I really don’t want to ground you again. I always feel bad afterward.
lines.zh: : 求你了,别因为我谵妄中说出的东西去杀人,Ami。我是真的不想再禁足你了。每次之后我都很难受。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t have to worry about that! I might know a bunch of stuff, but I’m no cardiologist! I have no idea how to actually keep a heart operating once it leaves its cage!
lines.zh: : 哦,那个你不用担心!我也许知道一堆事,但我又不是心脏病医生!心脏离开它的笼子之后要怎么继续跳动,我完全不懂!

lines.en: : Just know that, if you are lying to me right now, I’m going to be very very very VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY
lines.zh: : 你只要记住,如果你现在在骗我,我会非常非常非常非————常生气。

lines.en: : I’m incapable of lying in my current state. That’s why I have no choice but to tell you I have a boner right now, even if I’m currently playing the Anti-Ami route.
lines.zh: : 我在当前状态下没有撒谎的能力。这就是为什么我别无选择,只能告诉你:我现在勃起了,即便我此刻演的是 Anti-Ami 路线。

lines.en: : I knew that penetrating my own flesh with a safety pin would work! Boys are so predictable, I swear.
lines.zh: : 我就知道,用别针刺穿自己的肉一定有用!男孩就是好预测,我发誓。

lines.en: : Ami, what’s happening to me?
lines.zh: : Ami,我这是怎么了?

lines.en: : I already told you earlier, Dad! The ground we walk upon is becoming unstable!
lines.zh: : 我刚才不是说了吗,爸爸!我们脚踩的地面正在变得不稳定!

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation23
: I mean, just look! We’ve been halfway submerged this entire time and had no idea until we gained the perspective of an outsider! But that’s exactly how things are supposed to be here!
lines.zh: : 你看嘛!我们一直半淹在水里,却毫无察觉——直到借来了一个旁观者的视角!而这恰恰是这里本该有的样子!

lines.en: : I don’t get it. Please explain it to me in terms that even casual readers will understand.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。请用休闲读者也能听懂的方式解释给我。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation24
: We shouldn’t be fighting against all this weirdness, Dad. We should be embracing it! Because if something’s normal to us, who cares if it isn’t normal to anyone else?
lines.zh: : 我们不该和这些怪事对抗,爸爸。我们应该拥抱它们!因为如果一件事对我们来说是正常的,它对别人正不正常,谁在乎呢?

lines.en: : Whether it be having sex with your daughter, floating text about how cute I am, sex with your daughter, teleporting nine miles, or even having sex with your daughter! All of these things are only wrong if they’re real.
lines.zh: : 无论是和你的女儿做爱、浮现的「我好可爱」漂浮字、和你的女儿做爱、瞬移九英里,甚至——和你的女儿做爱!这些事只有当它们是「真的」时,才是错的。

lines.en: : So, as the only ones capable of defining our own respective realities, wouldn’t it make more sense for us to accept all the extra onion rings the world included with our fries and just friggin’ eat ‘em anyway?
lines.zh: : 那么,既然我们是仅有的、有能力定义各自现实的人,何不索性收下这个世界附赠在我们薯条里的每一圈额外的洋葱圈,然后照单全吃呢?

lines.en: : Is that really the simplest explanation possible?
lines.zh: : 这真是「最简单的解释」吗?

lines.en: : Beats me. I’m just a clingy teenage girl chasing after her own idea of happiness. And you’re-
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。我只是一个紧追着自己对幸福的定义的黏人少女。而你——

lines.en: : The huggy boy.
lines.zh: : 是抱抱男孩。

lines.en: : No. Wrong game. You’re my dad.
lines.zh: : 不。走错片场了。你是我爸爸。

lines.en: : We’re both normal people living normal lives and anyone who makes you question that or think there’s anything better outside of this world is intentionally leading you astray. Understood?
lines.zh: : 我们都是普通人,过着正常的日子。而任何让你质疑这一点、或让你以为这个世界之外还有更好东西的人,都是在故意把你带偏。明白吗?

lines.en: : So I don’t want to leave?
lines.zh: : 所以我并不想离开?

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation25
: Of course you don’t want to leave. Wanting to leave would be stupid.
lines.zh: : 你当然不想离开。想离开才是蠢的。

lines.en: : Do you know what happens to you out there, Dad?
lines.zh: : 你知道在外面你会遭遇什么吗,爸爸?

lines.en: : Do you know what happens to me?
lines.zh: : 你知道我会遭遇什么吗?

lines.en: : Accept the [[REDACTED] Spring. It is the last chance you have to live a life free of worry.
lines.zh: : 接受 [[REDACTED] 之春。这是你过上无忧无虑生活的最后机会。

lines.en: : What’s most important of all, though, is that you leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 不过最重要的是,你要离我远一点。

lines.en: : I love you too much to not tell you everything if you truly, earnestly ask.
lines.zh: : 我太爱你了,只要你真心、恳切地问,我没法不告诉你一切。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation22
: Anyway, that’s all! You should start coming down soon now that you’ve managed to mostly avoid any real form of confrontation again.
lines.zh: : 总之,就这些!你马上就能「落回地面」了——毕竟你又成功避开了任何一种真正形式的正面交锋。

lines.en: : Oh! I left a present for you in the sauna, by the way. Just don’t open it until tomorrow if you don’t want to ruin the entire weekend. Love you!
lines.zh: : 哦!顺便说一句,我在桑拿房里给你留了个礼物。要是你不想毁掉整个周末,明天之前别打开。爱你!

lines.en: : Don’t go looking for Kaori, Ami.
lines.zh: : 别去找 Kaori,Ami。

lines.en: scene amibeachteleportation26
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?
